name: Button
description: An action in a form, a dialog or a page: a label (and an optional icon) in a fully rounded shape. It comes in three sizes, a solid and an outline button in each brand color (Red and Blue on White, Cool Gray or Warm Gray; Rain on Blue or Azurite; White on Red or Oasis), and Bootstrap's role colors (success, danger, warning, info, light and dark), whose colors are Bootstrap's until marketing approves status colors. With keyboard focus, a button looks the way it does on hover, with a ring 2px outside it.
sources: Arizona Bootstrap 5.3.x buttons, from az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2281 (2026 brand buttons, which match the approved Adobe XD designs) and #2339
Figma Buttons component: the colors for each background, and the outline White buttons' hover text
az-digital/design#89: where the sources differ, Arizona Bootstrap wins; Bloom and Chili become Bougainvillea and Sonoran Red

root.description: The button: its shape, border and padding. Its colors come from its color variant. A button that's only an icon keeps the same height.

padding.y.$description: Button top and bottom padding, so with its 24px line and 2px border the button is 46px tall.

border.width.$description: Button border width, on every color, so outline and solid buttons are the same size.

border.radius.$description: Button corner radius: fully rounded ends (a pill) at every size.

gap.$description: Space between the label and an icon.

transition.duration.$description: How long a button takes to change color on hover and focus. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for a button's color changes. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

ring.offset.$description: Gap between the button and its keyboard focus ring.

font.family.$description: Button label typeface: Proxima Nova Condensed.
